adds.name: Swords to Plowshares
adds.why: Replaces Sword of the Animist (2nd copy). Commander is singleton, so the second copy isn't legal. Swap in 1-mana removal.

adds.name: Talisman of Conviction
adds.why: Replaces Bonders' Enclave. Colorless land in a 3-color deck. A 2-mana rock gets Cloud out a turn sooner.

adds.name: Austere Command
adds.why: Replaces Cultivate. He cut it from the precon, but with Vanquish the Horde and Decimate gone it's the deck's only board wipe, and it can spare Cloud (wipe creatures MV 3 or less).

adds.name: Stoneforge Mystic
adds.why: Replaces Bronze Guardian. Bronze Guardian is a slow wall. Stoneforge tutors Colossus Hammer or a Sword and drops it in for 2 mana.

adds.name: Cloud, Midgar Mercenary
adds.why: Replaces Avalanche of Sector 7. Avalanche is a narrow artifact punisher. The other Cloud is a 2-mana Equipment tutor that doubles Equipment triggers.

adds.name: Mother of Runes
adds.why: Replaces Barret Wallace. Filler body. Mother makes Cloud dodge removal or blockers every turn.

adds.name: Brass Squire
adds.why: Replaces Helitrooper. Helitrooper is a 2/2 flier. Squire attaches any Equipment for free every turn, including Colossus Hammer (equip 8).

adds.name: Sigarda's Aid
adds.why: Replaces Elena, Turk Recruit. Elena is low impact. Aid gives Equipment flash and attaches it free on entry.

adds.name: Steelshaper's Gift
adds.why: Replaces Professor Hojo. Hojo does little here. Gift is 1 mana for any Equipment.

adds.name: Hammer of Nazahn
adds.why: Replaces Cait Sith, Fortune Teller. Cait Sith is mostly flavor. Hammer auto-equips every Equipment that enters.

adds.name: Embercleave
adds.why: Replaces Summon: Kujata. Kujata is a 7-drop. Embercleave gives double strike and trample, usually for 2-3 mana in combat. With Colossus Hammer that's 30+ to the face.

adds.name: Fireshrieker
adds.why: Replaces Hellkite Tyrant. 6-mana dragon that doesn't help Cloud. Fireshrieker is double strike for 2 to equip.

adds.name: Akroma's Will
adds.why: Replaces Inspiring Statuary. Statuary is a weak mana rock. Akroma's Will is double strike plus protection: win or survive a wipe.

adds.name: Blackblade Reforged
adds.why: Replaces Conformer Shuriken. Shuriken is defensive. Blackblade is +1/+1 per land for equip 3 on Cloud.

adds.name: Buster Sword
adds.why: Replaces Hero's Heirloom. Heirloom is slow. Buster Sword is Cloud's own sword: big power plus free spells when he connects.

adds.name: Quietus Spike
adds.why: Replaces Wrecking Ball Arm. Arm sets power to 7 but costs a lot. Spike halves a player's life on every hit, and twice with double strike.

adds.name: Swiftfoot Boots
adds.why: Replaces Trailblazer's Boots. Nonbasic-landwalk only. Swiftfoot is a second haste + hexproof piece.

adds.name: Heroic Intervention
adds.why: Replaces Unfinished Business. 5-mana sorcery reanimation. Intervention stops a board wipe for 2.

adds.name: Boros Charm
adds.why: Replaces Vanquish the Horde. Wipes his own team. Boros Charm is instant double strike or indestructible, for 2.

adds.name: Path to Exile
adds.why: Replaces Decimate. Needs all four target types, often fizzles. Path is 1-mana exile.

adds.name: Shadowspear
adds.why: Replaces Dispatch. Dispatch only exiles with metalcraft. Shadowspear gives trample + lifelink for 1 so chump blocks stop working.

adds.name: Smothering Tithe
adds.why: Replaces Lifestream's Blessing. Expensive draw. Tithe is a Treasure engine (Game Changer #2; Gamble is #1).

adds.name: Enlightened Tutor
adds.why: Replaces Ultimate Magic: Holy. Expensive protection. Enlightened Tutor finds Embercleave or Colossus Hammer for 1 (Game Changer #3).

adds.name: Plaza of Heroes
adds.why: Land upgrade, replaces Scavenger Grounds. Any color for legendary spells, and can give Cloud hexproof + indestructible.

adds.name: Jetmir's Garden
adds.why: Land upgrade, replaces Ash Barrens. Naya triome; Forest type, so Nature's Lore can fetch it.

adds.name: Needleverge Pathway
adds.why: Land upgrade, replaces Path of Ancestry. Untapped R/W.

adds.name: Branchloft Pathway
adds.why: Land upgrade, replaces Radiant Grove. Untapped G/W.

adds.name: Cragcrown Pathway
adds.why: Land upgrade, replaces Sacred Peaks. Untapped R/G.

adds.name: Karplusan Forest
adds.why: Land upgrade, replaces Wooded Ridgeline. Untapped R/G painland, matches his Battlefield Forge and Brushland.

variants.bracketGoal: 3 Game Changers: Gamble, Enlightened Tutor, Smothering Tithe · fast, brutal voltron for a 4-player table
variants.label: B3
variants.name: Cloud (B3)
notes: Plan: tutor Equipment (Stoneforge, Cloud Midgar Mercenary, Enlightened Tutor, Gamble, Steelshaper's Gift), protect Cloud (Mother of Runes, Heroic Intervention, Boros Charm, Akroma's Will), then double strike. Tifa untaps the team after a 7+ power hit for extra combats. Quietus Spike + double strike takes 3/4 of a player's life in one hit.
Gamble is shared with the Hulk deck's B3 version. If only one copy, swap in Jeska's Will or Ancient Tomb here.
Bracket 3 check: 3 Game Changers, no 2-card infinite combos, no extra turns (extra combats are fine), no mass land denial.
Estimated value about $299. Not checked against your collection.
Nov 19: + Steelshaper's Gift, − Hero's Blade. Needs its own Steelshaper's Gift (Andrew's copy is in Winter Soldier).
